1.name: Void Adept
1.desc: Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Void Volley grants permanent stacks, increasing its damage and performance.

1.name: Anchored Core
1.desc: Increases Dark Heart Ritual duration and allows it to effectively deny objective channels.

1.name: Cloak of Shadows
1.desc: Grants utility buffs and defensive scaling when near void zones.

4.name: Cold Feet
4.desc: Shadow Mark duration is increased by 1 second, and heroes afflicted have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.

4.name: Dark Barrier
4.desc: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero or Minion, Xal'atath gains a Shield stacking up to 10% of maximum Health.

4.name: Void Acolyte
4.desc: Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley and causes the next use to deal increased damage and cost no Mana.

7.name: Toxic Mark
7.desc: Shadow Mark applies a toxic effect, causing targets to take additional damage over time and enabling reliable follow-up detonations.

7.name: Void Summoner
7.desc: Enhances minion interactions and wave-clear utility through dark magic scaling.

7.name: Silence of the Lamb
7.desc: Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground that Silences enemies inside when completed.

10.name: Void Eruption
10.desc: Channel a growing Void Orb, launch it to blind enemies, and detonate in a large area. Instantly fully empowered if cast on the Dark Heart.

10.name: Void Convergence
10.desc: Summon a portal that spawns relentless void minions to pressure nearby lanes and zone out enemy heroes.

13.name: Pull of the Dark Heart
13.desc: Dark Heart pulses pull enemies slightly closer and apply a Slow field to control positioning near choke points.

13.name: Dark Heart's Protection
13.desc: Adds defensive spell-shield utility and crowd-control mitigation while near active void structures.

13.name: Crushing Cascade
13.desc: Increases ability impact scaling against targets caught in multi-hit ability overlaps.

16.name: Marked Resilience
16.desc: Grants physical and spell armor while targets are affected by Shadow Mark.

16.name: Relentless Whispers
16.desc: Increases Basic Attack range and damage follow-up parameters following teleports.

16.name: Fractured Reality
16.desc: Void Volley projectiles leave behind a burning trail of fire that deals ongoing damage over time to enemies standing in it.

20.name: Harbinger's Consumption
20.desc: Passively empowers resource efficiency and heavily scales late-game execution potential.

20.name: Rift Invasion
20.desc: Enhances Void Convergence to spawn stronger elite void manifestations and increase portal durability.

20.name: Dueling Orbs
20.desc: Increases Void Volley target tracking accuracy and projectile velocity against isolated heroes.

20.name: Unstable Core
20.desc: When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a target afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames that continuously burns enemies over time.

20.name: Paradox Loop
20.desc: Allows activation to reset basic ability timers and instantly restore core combat capacity.
